description: Rotary dispenser that bolts through the side wall of a ~200 x 300 x 200 mm clip-lid cereal box: turn the knob to carry muesli through a drum-shaped chamber and out a chute below, no reaching inside the box required. Body, drum, cap, knob and an internal reinforcing ring around the wall port, plus a drill template for marking the port and screw holes before cutting the box.

hardware.notes: Through the flange, wall and ring into captive nuts; see dispenser_ring.stl's nut pockets.
Two through dispenser_cap.stl's bosses into nut traps in dispenser_body.stl, one retaining dispenser_knob.stl onto the drum shaft.
Captive in dispenser_body.stl's end-boss nut traps for the cap screws.

printing_notes: Print food-contact parts (dispenser_body, dispenser_drum, dispenser_cap, dispenser_knob, dispenser_ring) in a natural/uncoloured food-contact-grade PETG with a stainless or hardened-steel nozzle, not brass. Avoid PLA (softens under warm rinsing) and ABS/ASA (styrene-based). Layer lines trap crumbs — hand-wash and air-dry, never dishwasher.

The drum chamber hangs below the box's internal floor: with the box on a flat counter the chute mouth sits well below the counter line, so the dispenser end of the box needs to overhang the edge or the box needs to sit on a riser/shelf so a bowl fits under the chute.

Cut the wall port and four screw holes using dispenser_template.stl as a drill guide: hold it against the outside of the box wall with its engraved line on the box's internal floor, mark through the port and screw holes, then hole-saw the port and drill the screw holes.

Assembly order: seat dispenser_ring.stl on the box's inside face with its captive nuts, pass the four M4 x 40mm screws from outside through dispenser_body.stl's flange and the wall into the ring's nuts, drop dispenser_drum.stl into the body's chamber, fit dispenser_cap.stl over the open end with two M4 x 12mm screws into the body's nut traps, then press dispenser_knob.stl onto the drum's hex shaft and secure with the third M4 x 12mm screw.

One full turn of the knob carries roughly 76 ml (about 32 g) of muesli; about one and a half turns fills a normal bowl. pocket_depth and pocket_len (dispenser_drum.stl's customizer parameters) tune the dose without changing the drum's outer fit.
